collar_tag_req: The Owner of a Dog shall keep the Dog tag securely affixed on the Dog for which it was issued until renewed or replaced and no person shall use the tag on another dog.
dog_limit: No person shall keep more than a maximum of four (4) dogs per household and shall ensure that each dog is licensed.
notes: URL: https://www.bonnecherevalleytwp.com/download.php?dl=YToyOntzOjI6ImlkIjtzOjI6IjUzIjtzOjM6ImtleSI7aToxO30=. Standard animal control bylaw. No special exemptions or definitions for farm or livestock guardian dogs.

collar_tag_req: All dogs must be registered on or before the first day of March each and every year.
notes: URL: https://www.bonfieldtownship.com/township-services/animal-services/dogs/. While the full text of By-law 2025-36 is not publicly available, the municipality's animal services website clearly states that a 'Farm dog or farm cat' is exempt from the running at large provisions (leash law). They are not exempt from nuisance barking rules.

collar_tag_req: Upon payment of the licence fee, the owner shall be furnished with a tag and shall keep the tag securely fixed on the dog or cat at all times.
dog_limit: Limit of 3 dogs and/or cats at any given time in one dwelling.
notes: URL: https://www.ajax.ca/Modules/bylaws/Bylaw/Download/1d18be84-8f82-4259-91a1-f8ea30eb8751. Urban animal control bylaw. The bylaw defines 'working animal' but specifically excludes farm dogs from the definition.

lgd_definition: “Working Agricultural Livestock Guardian Dogs” shall mean a dog that is specifically trained to work and/or live with domestic farm animals (i.e. cattle, sheep, goats etc) without causing them harm while aggressively repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose.
collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog shall cause a dog tag to be securely affixed on the dog at all times.
dog_limit: No owner shall keep or permit to be kept more than three (3) dogs at any one time, per dwelling unit. Exception: an agricultural location with a valid farm registration number and registered with the Municipality may keep a maximum of five (5) working livestock guardian dogs.
notes: URL: https://www.brockton.ca/media/4akjyxam/by-law-2020-082-dog-control-by-law-set-fines-included.pdf. Very farm-friendly bylaw. Defines Working Agricultural Livestock Guardian Dogs, expressly exempts them from persistent barking restrictions (under Noise By-Law 2019-164 amendment), and permits up to 5 working LGDs per registered farm (exceeding the standard 3 dog limit without a kennel license).

collar_tag_req: Each owner shall keep a license tag securely fixed to their dog at all times.
notes: URL: https://www.calvintownship.ca/uploads/documents/by-laws/2007-013%20Dogs.pdf. Licenses are issued free of charge for the lifetime of all dogs. No specific provisions or exemptions exist for LGDs or farm dogs.

BYLAW NOT FOUND. Past council minutes (March 2016) explicitly state 'The municipality does not have an animal control by-law'. More recent minutes (November 2025) note that Council adopted By-Law 2025-44 for canine control, but no active bylaw is currently published or available on the municipal website to extract definitions from.

collar_tag_req: Upon payment of the Licence fee for a Dog, the Owner shall be furnished with a Tag and shall keep the Tag securely fixed on the Dog at all times until the Tag is renewed or replaced.
dog_limit: Owner, tenant or occupant of a Dwelling Unit, shall not own or harbor more than three (3) Dogs in any Dwelling Unit.
notes: URL: https://brucemines.ca/documents/dl/?fileID=19&catID=0. Standard animal control bylaw. While the bylaw exempts Police Working Dogs and Guide Dogs from 'running at large' provisions, there are no definitions or exemptions for livestock guardian dogs or farm dogs.

dog_limit: Not explicitly stated for general households; private kennels are limited to 8 dogs.
notes: URL: https://carlowmayo.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/15-2025-Dog-By-Law.pdf. Newly enacted By-Law 15-2025 replaces older by-laws. Previous by-laws had no explicit definitions or exemptions for farm dogs or LGDs, and 15-2025 maintains provisions for Service Dogs but no LGD exemptions.

collar_tag_req: The owner shall ensure that the dog tag is securely fixed on the dog at all times.
notes: URL: https://www.carling.ca/wp-content/uploads/10-Dog-By-law-2004-4.pdf. Farm Friendly Noise Exemption! While the Animal Control By-law itself restricts persistent barking, Carling's Noise By-Law No. 93-10 specifically prohibits 'Persistent barking, calling or whining... by any domestic pet or any other animal kept or used for any purpose OTHER THAN agriculture.' This explicitly exempts agricultural/farm dogs from the noise by-law's barking prohibitions. Also, dog tags are free for all residents if obtained prior to May 1st.

collar_tag_req: The Town of Carleton Place requires owners to register their cats or other animals with the municipality and to provide a means of identification in the manner of a Town issued registration tag or a microchip implanted by a qualified vet if that animal ever leaves the owners' premises.
dog_limit: No person or household shall keep more than three (3) dogs or four (4) cats or a total combined of five (5) pets in or about any dwelling unit.
notes: URL: https://carletonplace.ca/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Certified-Consolidated-Copy-Animal-Control-By-Law.pdf. Urban animal control bylaw. While service dogs are defined and accommodated, there are no definitions or exemptions provided for LGDs or farm dogs.
